subject: System
action: The studio work list must provide a create-work entry point in both the header and the empty state.
condition: While the studio work list screen is available to the user.
expectedOutcome: Selecting the create-work action navigates to /studio/works/new.

subject: System
action: The studio work list must show the empty state when there are no works to display.
condition: While works.length === 0 on the rendered screen.
expectedOutcome: The list is replaced by the empty-state prompt, including a create-work call to action.

subject: System
action: The studio work list must exclude deleted works.
condition: While works are being listed on this screen.
expectedOutcome: Only works with deleted_at equal to null appear in the rendered list.

subject: System
action: The studio work list must provide a per-work navigation path to the selected work's detail page.
condition: When the user clicks a work title on a listed card.

subject: System
action: The studio work list must render work cards in most-recent-first order and must not fail when synopsis is missing.
condition: When works are rendered as cards on the studio work list screen.
expectedOutcome: Cards appear in descending created_at order, and any missing synopsis is displayed as an empty string.

subject: System
action: The studio work list must load and display only works associated with the current authenticated user's id.
condition: When the studio work list screen mounts and a current user exists.
expectedOutcome: The screen requests works for that user only.

subject: authenticated user
action: Review your current writing projects in Studio and continue with an existing work or start from the empty-state create prompt.
